about: What people who get Social Security or SSI must report, and how soon. Wording follows Social Security's own booklets; where a booklet gives no time limit, none is invented.

rows.plain: For SSI, report a change as soon as possible and no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
For SSI, a late or missed report can reduce your payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
For retirement, survivors and disability benefits, Social Security's booklets say to report changes promptly. They give no fixed number of days.
If a change is not reported, you may be paid too much and have to pay the money back.
Giving false information on purpose, or knowingly failing to report, can stop benefits: 6 months for the first time, 12 for the second, 24 for the third.

rows.hours: Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 7 p.m.
rows.plain: You can report by phone, by mail or in person at your local Social Security office. Have the Beneficiary Notice Control (BNC) number from a letter about your benefits ready; it is not your Social Security number.
A change of address or direct deposit can be made online in a personal my Social Security account.

Social Security's booklets list other changes that must be reported, such as a warrant, a conviction, time in an institution, or a change in citizenship or immigration status. Read the list for your benefit.

rows.label: Address or phone number
rows.when: as soon as you know the new one
have_ready: The new address and phone number
The date of the move
The names of family members getting benefits who are moving with you
rows.plain: Report: address or phone number.

rows.label: Bank account for direct deposit
have_ready: The new account and routing numbers (give these only to Social Security, never to this tool)
rows.plain: Report: bank account for direct deposit.

rows.label: Starting or stopping work, or a change in pay or hours
have_ready: The date work started or stopped
Your employer's name
Your pay before tax and your hours
Any work expenses caused by your disability
rows.plain: Report: starting or stopping work, or a change in pay or hours.

rows.label: Yearly earnings that will be higher or lower than you told Social Security
have_ready: Your new estimate of earnings for the year
The month work started, stopped or changed
rows.plain: Report: yearly earnings that will be higher or lower than you told Social Security.

rows.label: Other income, including a spouse's income
have_ready: What the income is and who pays it
The amount and the date it started or changed
rows.plain: Report: other income, including a spouse's income.

rows.label: Savings or things you own (resources)
have_ready: What changed: a new resource, a sale, a transfer or a change in value
The amount and the date
rows.plain: Report: savings or things you own (resources).

rows.label: Where or with whom you live, or help with living expenses
have_ready: The new living arrangement and the date
Who lives in the household
Any help you get with food or shelter costs
rows.plain: Report: where or with whom you live, or help with living expenses.

rows.label: Marriage, separation or divorce
have_ready: The date
Your spouse's or former spouse's name
rows.plain: Report: marriage, separation or divorce.

rows.label: Name change
have_ready: Your old and new name
The marriage, divorce or court paper that shows it
rows.plain: Report: name change.

rows.label: A death in the family or household
have_ready: The person's name and date of death
rows.plain: Report: a death in the family or household.

rows.label: Leaving the United States for 30 days or more
have_ready: The date you leave and the date you plan to return
The country or countries
rows.plain: Report: leaving the United States for 30 days or more.

rows.label: A child in your care moves out or changes address
have_ready: The child's name
The name and address of the person the child now lives with
rows.plain: Report: a child in your care moves out or changes address.

rows.label: Another benefit or payment starts, changes or stops
have_ready: What the benefit is and who pays it
The amount and the date
rows.plain: Report: another benefit or payment starts, changes or stops.

rows.label: A pension from work that did not pay Social Security taxes
have_ready: Who pays the pension
The amount and the date it started or changed
rows.plain: Report: a pension from work that did not pay Social Security taxes.

rows.label: Your medical condition improves
have_ready: What has changed
The date you noticed it
Your doctor's name
rows.plain: Report: your medical condition improves.

rows.label: Going into or leaving a hospital, nursing home or other institution
have_ready: The name of the place
The date you went in or left
rows.plain: Report: going into or leaving a hospital, nursing home or other institution.

rows.label: School attendance, if under age 22
have_ready: The school's name
The date attendance started, stopped or changed
rows.plain: Report: school attendance, if under age 22.
